ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 24.5
   D. 8

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 30
   C. 46
   D. 23

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 22
   C. 88
   D. 38

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

14. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

15. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

16. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
